# Traefik Gateway with mkcert for agent-plm.local

## Target architecture

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  browser[Browser]
  traefik[Traefik_443_80]
  web[web_3000]
  api[api_8080]
  authelia[authelia_9091]
  cerbos[cerbos_3592]
  rustfsConsole[rustfs_console_9001]

  browser -->|"https://agent-plm.local"| traefik
  traefik -->|"/"| web
  traefik -->|"/api/* /q/*"| api
  traefik -->|"/authelia/*"| authelia
  traefik -->|"/cerbos/*"| cerbos
  traefik -->|"/rustfs/*"| rustfsConsole
```

**Confirmed routing (from your answers):**

| URL | Backend | Notes |
|-----|---------|-------|
| `https://agent-plm.local/` | `web:3000` | Next.js at root |
| `https://agent-plm.local/api/seasons` | `api:8080` | Keep current `/api/*` paths (no `v1`) |
| `https://agent-plm.local/q/health` | `api:8080` | Quarkus health/dev endpoints |
| `https://agent-plm.local/authelia` | `authelia:9091` | Authelia UI/OIDC |
| `https://agent-plm.local/cerbos` | `cerbos:3592` | Cerbos HTTP API (strip prefix) |
| `https://agent-plm.local/rustfs` | `rustfs:9001` | Console only; S3 stays internal at `rustfs:9000` |

Direct host ports (`8080`, `3000`, `9091`, etc.) remain published for transition, as requested.

---

## 1. mkcert certificate setup

**Add:** [`infra/gateway/tls/`](infra/gateway/tls/) (gitignored certs + `.gitkeep`)

**Replace** [`Makefile`](Makefile) `authelia-certs` with `gateway-certs`:

```makefile
gateway-certs:
	@command -v mkcert >/dev/null || { echo "Install mkcert: https://github.com/FiloSottile/mkcert"; exit 1; }
	@mkdir -p infra/gateway/tls
	mkcert -cert-file infra/gateway/tls/agent-plm.local.pem \
	       -key-file infra/gateway/tls/agent-plm.local-key.pem agent-plm.local
```

- Update `dev` target: `dev: gateway-certs` (remove `authelia-certs`)
- Add `gateway-certs-force` (regenerate)
- One-time host step (documented, not automated): `mkcert -install` and `/etc/hosts` entry:
  ```
  127.0.0.1 agent-plm.local
  ```

**Update** [`.gitignore`](.gitignore): ignore `infra/gateway/tls/*`, keep `.gitkeep`; remove obsolete `infra/authelia/tls/*` ignore once Authelia no longer needs local certs.

---

## 2. Add Traefik service (replace both nginx roles)

**Add:** [`infra/traefik/traefik.yml`](infra/traefik/traefik.yml) — static config:

- Entrypoints: `web` (:80) → redirect to `websecure` (:443)
- Docker provider (`exposedbydefault=false`)
- File provider for TLS cert paths (or inline in static config)
- Mount mkcert PEMs from `infra/gateway/tls/`

**Add Traefik service** to [`docker-compose.yml`](docker-compose.yml):

```yaml
traefik:
  image: traefik:v3.3
  ports:
    - "80:80"
    - "443:443"
  volumes:
    - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
    - ./infra/traefik/traefik.yml:/etc/traefik/traefik.yml:ro
    - ./infra/gateway/tls:/certs:ro
  depends_on:
    - api
    - web
    - authelia
    - cerbos
    - rustfs
```

**Route via Docker labels** on each backend service (cleaner than maintaining separate route files):

| Service | Traefik labels (concept) |
|---------|--------------------------|
| `web` | `Host(agent-plm.local) && PathPrefix(/)` with lower priority; port 3000 |
| `api` | `Host(agent-plm.local) && (PathPrefix(/api) \|\| PathPrefix(/q))`; port 8080 |
| `authelia` | `Host(agent-plm.local) && PathPrefix(/authelia)`; port 9091 |
| `cerbos` | `Host(agent-plm.local) && PathPrefix(/cerbos)` + `stripprefix.prefixes=/cerbos`; port 3592 |
| `rustfs` | `Host(agent-plm.local) && PathPrefix(/rustfs)` + strip prefix; port 9001 (console) |

All routers use `entrypoints=websecure`, `tls=true`.

**Remove from compose:**

- `authelia-gateway` service entirely ([`docker-compose.yml`](docker-compose.yml) lines 67–76)
- `nginx` service from [`docker-compose.prod.yml`](docker-compose.prod.yml)

**Delete obsolete nginx configs:**

- [`infra/nginx/default.conf`](infra/nginx/default.conf)
- [`infra/authelia/nginx-gateway.conf`](infra/authelia/nginx-gateway.conf)

---

## 3. Authelia: drop nginx TLS, configure subpath + new domain

**Update** [`infra/authelia/configuration.yml`](infra/authelia/configuration.yml):

- Replace `plm.lvh.me` → `agent-plm.local` in access rules and session cookie domain
- Set external URLs:
  - `authelia_url: https://agent-plm.local/authelia`
  - `default_redirection_url: https://agent-plm.local/`
- Add Authelia 4 subpath config (`server.path: /authelia` per Authelia docs) so OIDC/session endpoints work behind Traefik without stripping the path

**Update** [`infra/authelia/docker-entrypoint.sh`](infra/authelia/docker-entrypoint.sh):

- Remove TLS cert copy/check (Traefik terminates TLS now)
- Update startup message to `https://agent-plm.local/authelia`

Authelia stays HTTP-only internally on `:9091` (same as today behind nginx, but nginx is removed).

---

## 4. Environment and app config updates

**Update** [`.env.example`](.env.example) and [`apps/web/nextjs/.env.example`](apps/web/nextjs/.env.example) with gateway-oriented defaults (commented or primary):

```env
PLM_PUBLIC_URL=https://agent-plm.local
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://agent-plm.local
PLM_CORS_ORIGINS=https://agent-plm.local
PLM_OIDC_ISSUER=https://agent-plm.local/authelia
```

Keep localhost port vars documented as fallback for direct access during transition.

**No API path changes** — resources stay at `/api/seasons`, `/api/health`, etc. Web client already builds URLs as `${NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/seasons`.

**Internal service URLs unchanged** (container-to-container):

- API → `http://cerbos:3592`, `http://rustfs:9000` (not through Traefik)

---

## 5. Documentation and cleanup

**Update docs:**

- [`infra/README.md`](infra/README.md) — Traefik + mkcert instead of nginx
- [`infra/authelia/README.md`](infra/authelia/README.md) — new URL, remove nginx-gateway references
- [`README.md`](README.md) / [`docs/wiki/Local-Development.md`](docs/wiki/Local-Development.md) — gateway setup steps, hosts entry, mkcert prerequisite
- [`PLM_SPEC.md`](PLM_SPEC.md) — replace nginx references with Traefik where relevant

**Verify CI still passes:** [`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml) `compose config` merge of all three compose files.

---

## 6. Verification checklist (post-implementation)

1. `make gateway-certs && make dev`
2. Confirm routes:
   - `https://agent-plm.local/` → Next.js UI
   - `https://agent-plm.local/api/seasons` → JSON list
   - `https://agent-plm.local/q/health` → Quarkus health
   - `https://agent-plm.local/authelia` → Authelia login
   - `https://agent-plm.local/cerbos/_cerbos/health` (or equivalent Cerbos health path after strip)
   - `https://agent-plm.local/rustfs` → RustFS console
3. Confirm fallback still works: `http://localhost:3000`, `http://localhost:8080/api/seasons`
4. Browser shows trusted cert (mkcert CA installed)

**Risk to watch:** RustFS console may not fully support subpath hosting. If `/rustfs` breaks assets/redirects, fallback options are Traefik `replacepathregex` middleware or a dedicated subdomain later — test early.

Checking the seasons route structure and what each `page.tsx` does.

[REDACTED]

In Next.js App Router, **`page.tsx` defines a route**. Each folder under `src/app/` is a URL segment, so Seasons has three pages because it has three screens:

```
src/app/seasons/
├── page.tsx          →  /seasons
├── new/
│   └── page.tsx      →  /seasons/new
└── [id]/
    └── page.tsx      →  /seasons/:id   (e.g. /seasons/abc-123)
```

### What each one does

| File | URL | Purpose |
|------|-----|---------|
| [`seasons/page.tsx`](apps/web/nextjs/src/app/seasons/page.tsx) | `/seasons` | **List page** — shows all seasons via `SeasonList`, with a “New season” link |
| [`seasons/new/page.tsx`](apps/web/nextjs/src/app/seasons/new/page.tsx) | `/seasons/new` | **Create page** — empty `SeasonForm`, calls `createSeason()`, then redirects to the detail page |
| [`seasons/[id]/page.tsx`](apps/web/nextjs/src/app/seasons/[id]/page.tsx) | `/seasons/{id}` | **Detail/edit page** — loads one season, edit form, “Close season” (archive) |

### Why separate files?

This matches standard CRUD UI patterns:

- **List** — browse all records  
- **New** — create flow  
- **Detail** — view/edit one record by ID  

The `[id]` folder is a **dynamic route** — Next.js uses the URL segment as `params.id` (see `useParams` in the detail page).

Shared UI (`SeasonList`, `SeasonForm`, `AppShell`) lives in `src/components/`; each `page.tsx` only wires up layout + behavior for that route. That’s the pattern used for every entity in this project (see the create-plm-entity skill).

# Quarkus Authentication via Authelia OIDC

## Answer: Traefik vs Authelia vs Quarkus?

Use **all three, but with separate jobs** (matches [PLM_SPEC.md](PLM_SPEC.md) §22–23):

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  browser[Browser_or_API_client]
  traefik[Traefik]
  authelia[Authelia_AuthN]
  quarkus[Quarkus_API]
  cerbos[Cerbos_AuthZ_later]

  browser -->|"HTTPS"| traefik
  traefik -->|"/authelia/*"| authelia
  traefik -->|"/api/*"| quarkus
  authelia -->|"issues OIDC JWT"| browser
  browser -->|"Authorization: Bearer JWT"| quarkus
  quarkus -->|"validate JWT"| authelia
  quarkus -.->|"later"| cerbos
```

| Layer | Role in this task | Do now? |
|-------|-------------------|---------|
| **Authelia** | AuthN: login portal, user store, **OIDC issuer** (JWTs) | Yes — users + OIDC provider |
| **Traefik** | TLS + path routing only | No forward-auth (per your request) |
| **Quarkus** | AuthN enforcement: validate Bearer JWT on API requests | Yes — primary deliverable |
| **Cerbos** | AuthZ (permissions) | Out of scope for this task |

**Why not Traefik forward-auth alone?** It only checks Authelia session cookies at the edge. API clients (curl, Postman, future UI) need **Bearer tokens**, and the API must know **who** the caller is — that belongs in Quarkus.

**Why Authelia is still required:** Quarkus should not store passwords or issue tokens. Authelia remains the identity boundary; Quarkus trusts JWTs signed by Authelia’s JWKS.

**Without UI changes:** developers obtain tokens by logging in through Authelia’s portal + OAuth2 authorization-code flow (Postman or a small script). Logging into `/authelia` alone does **not** attach auth to `/api/*` calls until a Bearer token is sent.

---

## 1. Authelia: three test users

**File:** [`infra/authelia/users_database.yml`](infra/authelia/users_database.yml)

Add/replace with:

| Username | Password | Groups |
|----------|----------|--------|
| `admin` | `admin` | `admins`, `dev` |
| `planner` | `planner` | `planners` |
| `viewer` | `viewer` | `viewers` |

Generate Argon2id hashes via Authelia CLI (add Makefile target `authelia-hash`):

```bash
docker run --rm authelia/authelia:4 authelia crypto hash generate argon2 --password 'admin'
```

Commit only the hashed passwords, not plaintext.

---

## 2. Authelia: enable OIDC provider

**File:** [`infra/authelia/configuration.yml`](infra/authelia/configuration.yml)

Add `identity_providers.oidc` block:

- **Issuer (external):** `https://agent-plm.local/authelia`
- **JWKS signing key:** generate once, store under [`infra/authelia/oidc/`](infra/authelia/oidc/) (gitignored private key + cert; `.gitkeep` tracked)
- **OIDC client** `plm-api` (confidential):
  - `client_secret`: dev placeholder (also in `.env.example`)
  - `grant_types`: `authorization_code`, `refresh_token`
  - `scopes`: `openid`, `profile`, `email`, `groups`
  - `redirect_uris`: include Postman callback `https://oauth.pstmn.io/v1/callback` for manual testing without UI

**Makefile:** add `authelia-oidc-keys` to generate JWKS material if missing.

**Entrypoint:** [`infra/authelia/docker-entrypoint.sh`](infra/authelia/docker-entrypoint.sh) — copy OIDC key material into `/config` alongside existing bootstrap files.

---

## 3. Quarkus: OIDC bearer validation

### Dependencies

Add to [`apps/api/quarkus/pom.xml`](apps/api/quarkus/pom.xml):

- `quarkus-oidc`
- `quarkus-security` (for `@Authenticated`, HTTP permissions)

### Configuration

**File:** [`apps/api/quarkus/src/main/resources/application.yml`](apps/api/quarkus/src/main/resources/application.yml)

```yaml
quarkus:
  oidc:
    enabled: true
    application-type: service          # bearer-only; no login redirect in API
    auth-server-url: ${PLM_OIDC_AUTH_SERVER_URL:http://authelia:9091/authelia}
    token:
      issuer: ${PLM_OIDC_ISSUER:https://agent-plm.local/authelia}
    client-id: plm-api
    credentials:
      secret: ${PLM_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET:local-dev-plm-api-secret}
    tls:
      verification: none               # dev only; Authelia reached over internal HTTP
  http:
    auth:
      permission:
        public:
          paths: /api/health,/api/info,/q/health,/q/health/*
          policy: permit
        authenticated:
          paths: /api/*
          policy: authenticated
```

**Compose env** in [`docker-compose.yml`](docker-compose.yml) for `api` service:

```yaml
PLM_OIDC_AUTH_SERVER_URL: http://authelia:9091/authelia
PLM_OIDC_ISSUER: https://agent-plm.local/authelia
PLM_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET: local-dev-plm-api-secret
```

Internal URL for JWKS discovery; external issuer matches JWT `iss` claim (Authelia subpath setup).

### `%test` profile

Disable OIDC in tests so existing unit tests keep passing:

```yaml
"%test":
  quarkus:
    oidc:
      enabled: false
    http:
      auth:
        permission:
          authenticated:
            paths: /*
            policy: permit
```

### Error handling

Add [`UnauthorizedExceptionMapper.java`](apps/api/quarkus/src/main/java/io/agentplm/api/UnauthorizedExceptionMapper.java) — map 401 to `{"error":"..."}` JSON (consistent with existing mappers).

### Optional identity hook (minimal)

Add small [`IdentitySupport.java`](apps/api/quarkus/src/main/java/io/agentplm/api/IdentitySupport.java) reading `preferred_username` from `JsonWebToken` / `SecurityIdentity` for future audit fields. **Do not** wire `createdBy`/`updatedBy` yet (those columns are `UUID`, usernames are strings).

---

## 4. Protect existing resources

No changes to resource method signatures needed — HTTP permissions cover all of [`SeasonResource`](apps/api/quarkus/src/main/java/io/agentplm/api/season/SeasonResource.java) automatically.

Expected behavior:

| Request | Result |
|---------|--------|
| `GET /api/health` | 200 (public) |
| `GET /api/seasons` without token | 401 |
| `GET /api/seasons` with valid Bearer JWT | 200 |
| Invalid/expired token | 401 |

---

## 5. Testing (no Next.js)

### Manual verification flow

1. `make dev` (Authelia + API up)
2. Confirm users can log in at `https://agent-plm.local/authelia` with `admin`/`admin`, etc.
3. Obtain access token via **Postman OAuth 2.0**:
   - Auth URL: `https://agent-plm.local/authelia/api/oidc/authorization`
   - Token URL: `https://agent-plm.local/authelia/api/oidc/token`
   - Client ID: `plm-api`, Client Secret: from `.env.example`
   - Scope: `openid profile email groups`
4. Call API:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://agent-plm.local/api/seasons
curl https://agent-plm.local/api/seasons          # expect 401
```

### Automated tests

Add [`SeasonResourceAuthIT.java`](apps/api/quarkus/src/test/java/io/agentplm/api/season/SeasonResourceAuthIT.java) using REST Assured + `@TestProfile` that enables OIDC with a test JWT (Quarkus `SmallRyeJwt` test utilities) — or profile-gated integration test run in CI when Docker stack is available.

Update [`.env.example`](.env.example) with `PLM_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` and document token acquisition in [`infra/authelia/README.md`](infra/authelia/README.md) and [`docs/wiki/Local-Development.md`](docs/wiki/Local-Development.md).

---

## 6. Explicitly out of scope

- Next.js login, middleware, or session handling
- Traefik `forwardAuth` middleware
- Cerbos policy enforcement
- MFA, password reset flows
- Production secret management

---

## Files to change (summary)

| Area | Files |
|------|-------|
| Authelia users | `infra/authelia/users_database.yml` |
| Authelia OIDC | `infra/authelia/configuration.yml`, `infra/authelia/oidc/*`, `docker-entrypoint.sh` |
| Quarkus auth | `pom.xml`, `application.yml`, `UnauthorizedExceptionMapper`, `IdentitySupport` |
| Compose/env | `docker-compose.yml`, `.env.example` |
| Tooling/docs | `Makefile`, `infra/authelia/README.md`, `docs/wiki/Local-Development.md` |
| Tests | `%test` profile, optional `SeasonResourceAuthIT` |

- Point Quarkus OIDC discovery at `https://agent-plm.local/authelia` instead of `http://authelia:9091/authelia`
- Add `extra_hosts: agent-plm.local:host-gateway` on the `api` service so the container can reach Traefik on the host
- Updated [`application.yml`](apps/api/quarkus/src/main/resources/application.yml), [`docker-compose.yml`](docker-compose.yml), `.env`, and `.env.example`

Here is a consolidated summary of what changed in this repo through the **Traefik gateway**, **local HTTPS**, and **Quarkus + Authelia auth** work.

**Git state:** You are on branch **`Auth`**, at commit **`77838f3`** (`updated DNS`), same as **`main`**. The **Quarkus OIDC / Authelia auth** work below is mostly **uncommitted** (modified + new files). Traefik/gateway work is largely in **`77838f3`**.

---

## 1. Local HTTPS gateway (Traefik + mkcert)

**Goal:** Single entry at `https://agent-plm.local` instead of separate nginx instances and `plm.lvh.me:9091`.

| Change | Details |
|--------|---------|
| **Traefik** | New `infra/traefik/` (static config + `dynamic/routes.yml` + TLS). Routes by path on `agent-plm.local`. |
| **Routing** | `/` → web, `/api/*` & `/q/*` → API, `/authelia/*` → Authelia, `/cerbos/*` → Cerbos (strip prefix), `/rustfs/*` → RustFS console (strip prefix). |
| **Removed** | `authelia-gateway` nginx, prod `nginx` service, `infra/nginx/default.conf`, `infra/authelia/nginx-gateway.conf`. |
| **TLS** | `infra/gateway/tls/` + `make gateway-certs` (mkcert for `agent-plm.local`). |
| **Makefile** | `gateway-certs`, `gateway-check` (requires `/etc/hosts` entry). |
| **Docs** | README, `infra/README.md`, `docs/wiki/Local-Development.md`, `PLM_SPEC.md` (nginx → Traefik). |

**Fix (Traefik Docker provider):** Routing moved to **file-based** config in `dynamic/routes.yml` so Traefik does not need the Docker socket (avoided macOS Docker API errors).

---

## 2. Authelia behind Traefik (`agent-plm.local`)

| Change | Details |
|--------|---------|
| **Domain** | `plm.lvh.me` → `agent-plm.local`. |
| **Subpath** | `server.address: tcp://0.0.0.0:9091/authelia` (no separate deprecated `server.path`). |
| **Entrypoint** | No longer copies TLS into Authelia; Traefik terminates HTTPS. |
| **Config** | Static `configuration.yml` replaced by **`configuration.template.yml`** + entrypoint injecting OIDC PEMs from `infra/authelia/oidc/`. |

---

## 3. Web / CORS (gateway-friendly, UI not wired to login)

| Change | Details |
|--------|---------|
| **`api-url.ts`** | Empty `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` → same-origin `/api/...` through Traefik (avoids CORS to `localhost:8080`). |
| **Env defaults** | `PLM_CORS_ORIGINS`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`, gateway URLs in `.env.example`. |
| **API CORS default** | Includes `https://agent-plm.local`. |
| **UI** | **No login/OIDC in Next.js** (by design). Seasons UI will get **401** on API until UI auth is added later. |

---

## 4. Quarkus authentication (Authelia OIDC) — mostly **uncommitted**

**Goal:** AuthN in the **API only**; Authelia issues tokens; Quarkus validates Bearer JWTs.

| Area | What was added |
|------|----------------|
| **Authelia users** | `admin`/`admin`, `planner`/`planner`, `viewer`/`viewer` (Argon2id in `users_database.yml`). |
| **Authelia OIDC** | Provider in template: client `plm-api`, scopes incl. `offline_access`, Postman redirect URI, JWKS keys via `make authelia-oidc-keys`. |
| **Quarkus** | `quarkus-oidc` + `quarkus-security`; `application-type: service`; protect `/api/*` except `/api/health`, `/api/info`, `/q/health`. |
| **Java** | `IdentitySupport`, `UnauthorizedExceptionMapper` (401 JSON). |
| **Compose** | API `depends_on: authelia`; OIDC env vars; **`extra_hosts: agent-plm.local:host-gateway`**. |
| **Tests** | `SeasonResourceAuthIT`, `AuthEnforcementTestProfile`, `UnauthorizedExceptionMapperTest`; auth off in `%test`. |
| **Tooling** | `make authelia-hash`, `make authelia-oidc-keys`; `dev` runs OIDC key generation. |

---

## 5. OIDC discovery fix (400 from direct Authelia HTTP)

**Problem:** `http://authelia:9091/authelia/.well-known/openid-configuration` returned **400**; works only via Traefik with proper forwarded HTTPS/host semantics.

**Fix:** `PLM_OIDC_AUTH_SERVER_URL=https://agent-plm.local/authelia` and API container **`extra_hosts`** so Quarkus discovers OIDC/JWKS through Traefik, matching issuer `https://agent-plm.local/authelia`.

---

## Architecture (current)

```text
Browser / API client
    → Traefik (443) @ agent-plm.local
        → /           → Next.js
        → /api/*      → Quarkus (Bearer JWT required except health/info)
        → /authelia/* → Authelia (login + OIDC)
        → /cerbos/*   → Cerbos (not enforced in app yet)
        → /rustfs/*   → RustFS console

Quarkus OIDC discovery/JWKS → https://agent-plm.local/authelia (via host-gateway)
```

**Not done:** Traefik forward-auth, Cerbos enforcement in API, Next.js login, MFA, production secrets.

---

## Uncommitted files (Auth work — commit when ready)

**New:** `IdentitySupport.java`, `UnauthorizedExceptionMapper.java`, tests under `security/`, `configuration.template.yml`, `infra/authelia/oidc/` (keys gitignored).

**Modified:** `pom.xml`, `application.yml`, `docker-compose.yml`, Authelia users/entrypoint/README, `.env.example`, Makefile, docs.

**Deleted:** `infra/authelia/configuration.yml` (replaced by template + entrypoint).

---

1. `/etc/hosts`: `127.0.0.1 agent-plm.local`  
2. `make gateway-certs` + `make authelia-oidc-keys`  
3. `make dev`  
4. Portal: `https://agent-plm.local/authelia` (test users above)  
5. Token: Postman OAuth (see `infra/authelia/README.md`)  
6. API: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://agent-plm.local/api/seasons` → 200; without token → 401
